description: Renders an AI answer's markdown as it streams: finished blocks stay put while only the last one grows, each new block rises in, unfinished syntax reads as it will once closed, and a slim caret marks where the text is arriving.
moves: Each block is drawn from its own source, so finished blocks never re-render or move while the text after them arrives.
A new block fades up out of a soft blur as it starts.
While streaming, a slim caret sits at the end of the text and pulses softly; it stays still for reduced motion.
Fenced code arrives line by line in Keyframery's code block, and its copy key appears when the closing fence lands.
keyboard: Moves to the next link, then to a code block's code and its copy button.
Opens the focused link. Links to other sites open in a new tab.

propDocs.Markdown.children: The markdown, as a string. `content` works too.
propDocs.Markdown.streaming: True while the text is still arriving: an unclosed `**`, fence, link or table row reads as it will once closed, and the caret shows.
propDocs.Markdown.caret: Show the caret while streaming. Default true.
propDocs.Markdown.components: Your own element for any tag (`p`, `h1` to `h6`, `a`, `strong`, `em`, `del`, `code`, `ul`, `ol`, `li`, `blockquote`, `hr`, `table` and its parts), and `codeBlock` for fenced code. Keep the object stable.
propDocs.Markdown.className: Classes for the root, which lays the blocks out in a column.

cssVars: Quotes, list markers and table headers
